summary: Frontend-only verification of the redesigned Partner Settlement Dashboard (/partner-settlement) for both super-admin and partner personas. All specified data-testid contracts, KPIs, filters, charts, center-card expand, contributing-txns dialog, settle dialog, history dialog, and dashboard cleanup checks pass. Zero blocking issues.

issues: Chart X-axis labels are auto-truncated center names like 'TEST_iter19_cen…' — expected for test data with long TEST_ prefixes, not a code bug. On real tenants center names are shorter (e.g. 'Birsa Kairo').

verified_flows: ADMIN (admin@finance.app/Admin@123) → /partner-settlement renders data-testid=settlement-dashboard. All 8 KPI cards populated with real values (Income ₹37,77,339, Expense ₹34,90,130, P/L ₹2,87,209, Partner Share -₹1,44,968, Fair Share ₹17,65,547, To Receive ₹5,26,383, To Pay ₹5,26,383, Settled Amount ₹0). settlement-filters + all 8 filter controls (filter-company/center/partner/cycle/status/start/end + clear-filters) present. settlement-charts renders 5 recharts. center-overview shows 132 center-card-toggle-* cards.
CENTER EXPAND: Clicking a center-card-toggle-<id> reveals center-detail-<id> with the partner table. view-txns-current-<id> opens txn-drill-dialog with totals + rows/empty state. Close works.

SETTLE DUES: Found settle-btn-<centerId>-<partnerId> after expanding 18 admin cards with pending adjustments. Clicking opens settle-dialog exposing settle-to-partner (select), settle-amount, settle-date, settle-note fields. Cancel closes without submitting.

FILTERS: filter-status=Settled dynamically re-renders the center list (all 132 cards shown as 'Settled' bucket per statuses; 80 cards remained after prior filter combos — filter is reactive). Clear Filters resets to defaults.
SETTLED HISTORY: open-history-btn opens history-dialog which correctly shows empty state 'No settlements recorded yet.' (0 records in DB, expected per E1 note).

PARTNER (kumarshailendra259@gmail.com/Test@1234) → /select-company (data-testid=company-select-page) → picked Partner-role company 73bb261d-… → /partner-settlement shows EXACTLY 2 centers: 'Birsa Kairo' (Settled) and 'Palojori Deoghar' (Pending). No other centers leak. KPIs match spec exactly: Total Income ₹5,000, Fair Share/Partner ₹32,500, To Receive ₹550, To Pay ₹550, Settled Amount ₹0.

SIDEBAR ISOLATION (partner): No /companies-admin or /center-management links in DOM (admin_leak=[]). Sidebar only exposes Dashboard, Org Mgmt, Finance, Approvals, Candidate, Employee, Procurement, Partnerships groups.
DASHBOARD CLEAN: Main / dashboard for the partner does NOT contain data-testid=settlement-section (verified absent). Redesign removal confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: SettlementDashboard.jsx is ~940 lines with 5 chart blocks, 3 dialogs, filters, KPI section, and CenterDetail helper inline. Consider splitting KPIs, Charts, CenterCard, CenterDetail, HistoryDialog, SettleDialog, TxnDrillDialog into separate files (>700 line rule).

loadSettlement() catch swallows the error silently and sets an empty centers array — a genuine 500 from /dashboard/settlement would look identical to 'no data' in the UI. Consider surfacing a toast.error on failure (only the two /entities/* company-map calls should stay silent).

kpis useMemo depends on `useLifetime` implicitly via centerVals but the dependency array does not list useLifetime (though `filters` is listed, which transitively covers it — still worth an explicit reference for readability).
In shareData Others slice — the 'Others' bucket has no unique key/color guarantee (uses index only) — fine visually, but consider a stable color for 'Others'.
toRecv/toPay per-card are recomputed twice (once inside kpis loop and once inside center-overview map) — minor perf, negligible at 132 centers.
